body:
Are you using any AI tools in any part of this PR? Please see our [contribution guidelines](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/organization/general_rules_and_guidelines.html#ai-assisted-contributions)

The language in this is not aligning very well with our general style and complexity, the language is not very accessible

> The language used in this PR aligns very little with anything ever written before in the class reference. It is way too technical. The methods being described, despite the fact that they are meant to be overridden, do not provide instructions on what _could_ be implemented, but are rather worded as if they do something on their own.
> 
> Please take a look at existing documentation _at least_ as a point of inspiration.
> 
> Let me accentuate this, because we take it very seriously. If AI was used in the making of this PR, please disclose it.

I understand your concern, and no, AI was not used in making this PR. I definitely did spend a ton (a lot of hours) of time reading through documentation and related classes. The Godot project is huge, so it was hard to know even where to begin, but this PR documentation is something I wrote after spending a lot of time reading the base class and many other related classes to understand the networking functionality. I think the best excuse I could muster is that I am a computer science student in university, and have been forced to focus a lot on the commenting of any code I write... I think this makes my comments overly verbose or just too much in general....

That said, I do understand your feedback, and will make sure that any subsequent submissions adhere more closely to the guidelines. I will also go through and read more of the existing documentation to ensure that I am maintaining the written style.

My apologies... I really do want to be a worthwhile contributor to the Godot project. I'll make sure that my future contributions are better!
